description: This file contains shell functions related to platform-specific upgrade processes, including image validation, copying configuration, and performing the system upgrade for a specific hardware platform.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image by comparing partition layouts between the device and the image.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the target partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the full upgrade process, including image writing and partition adjustments.
